# iosxe_voice_register_global (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Register Global configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_register_global" "example" {
  max_dn                 = 100
  max_pool               = 50
  system_message         = "CUBE SRST"
  security_policy_secure = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `max_dn` (Number) Maximum directory numbers supported
  - Range: `1`-`3500`
- `max_pool` (Number) Maximum pools to support
  - Range: `1`-`2500`
- `security_policy_secure` (Boolean) Only SIP TLS registration allowed
- `system_message` (String) Define system message

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_register_global.example ""
```
